hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: UI chrome is genuinely designed (Inter font, card shadow, blue/green button palette, proper hierarchy color inheritance from Tableau10) but the 900×900 SVG is clipped vertically in the screenshot and the bundled edges create a muddy dark mass where the two cluster groups converge, undermining the encoding.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force/size encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent and root.height, key functions on both node and link joins; no zero-baseline violations apply to this topological chart type.
flags: Update Storm: tension-slider fires redrawLinks() (300 path updates) on every input event without debouncing or RAF coalescing
Mid-Flight Snap: no .interrupt() call before starting new transitions; on('interrupt') handler does not sync d.current_x/y to final values leaving stale positional state
Mouse-Touch Fight: drag and click/mouseover handlers have no event.sourceEvent filtering or touch-vs-mouse disambiguation
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Three interaction robustness violations: un-throttled slider redraws, missing .interrupt() before layout transitions, and no touch/mouse event guard.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout switching keeps working memory load low and color hierarchy (up to 10 Tableau hues) is well-managed, but 300 bundled edges produce a visible dense mass in the circle-pack view, the control surface (8 layout buttons, tension slider, easing select, 3 checkboxes, FPS display) is substantial, and simultaneous shape-morphing of 200+ nodes on every layout switch creates animation noise that can't be fully assessed from a static screenshot.
